Method of Attack: DLL hijacking combined with mock directories to bypass Windows 10 UAC security feature and run elevated commands without user prompts
Using mock directories with trailing spaces to trick Windows into loading malicious DLLs instead of legitimate ones
Sideloading malicious DLLs by placing them alongside legitimate executables in mock directories
Renaming malicious DLLs to names expected by executables to trigger loading and execution
Attack Vector: DLL hijacking via mock directories with trailing spaces in Windows system folders
Exploitation of trusted system executables that auto-elevate privileges and sideload DLLs
